- Plugins: Connect to authoritative data sources like Wind and S&P. Professional data at your fingertips, for trustworthy analysis.
- Multi-Claw Group Chat: You can now pull the Claws into a group chat and invite human friends for real-time interaction and parallel collaboration. 
- Sync Across Devices: Seamlessly switch between phone, computer, and web. Your conversations stay in sync in real time.
- Office Agent: Kimi Agent is now with Office Pilot. It not only supports lossless swaps across PPT, Word, Excel, and PDF, but also delivers human-expert level processing.

Most people do not lose because they do not care.

They lose because the moment hits, the phone is already in their hand, and the promise they made in the morning has no system behind it.

Urge gives you that system.

WHY URGE WORKS DIFFERENTLY*

Urge is not just a softer browser filter.

It combines blocking, friction, crisis tools, education, breathwork, and progress tracking so you are not relying on willpower alone.

Because willpower is usually the first thing to disappear.

DUAL-LAYER WEBSITE BLOCKING*

Urge helps you create real friction between you and the loop:

- Website Blocker using Apple's Screen Time web filtering
- DNS Protection with a family-safe DNS profile
- Content category restrictions you control
- App removal prevention while protection is active
- Protection status checks so you know what is on
- Restore flows when a protection layer needs attention
- A disable cooldown that gives you a moment to choose again

No blocker is magic. The point is to make relapse harder at the exact second your brain wants easy.

PANIC BUTTON FOR HIGH-RISK MOMENTS*

When you are close to relapsing, open the Panic Button.

WHAT IS MOMO
Momo is your magical self-care pet — a tiny, ancient spirit that helps you sleep better, practice gratitude, build habits, and stay motivated through gentle guidance and playful rewards.

SO, IS IT JUST A HABIT TRACKER?
Not exactly. Momo isn’t a boring checklist or another wellness app. It’s a gamified self-care companion that turns your daily habits — from sleep and gratitude to small wins like brushing your teeth — into joyful quests with real rewards.

Because real life is overwhelming. Research shows that tracking habits, practicing gratitude, and getting consistent sleep improves well-being — but most apps make it feel like homework. Momo makes it feel fun, like getting encouraged by a little ancient creature who’s rooting for you.

HOW DOES MOMO WORK?
Each day, Momo nudges you to:

Track your sleep by placing your phone on your bed

Complete one simple gratitude prompt

Pick a few small habits to complete (or create your own)

Earn Momo Coins to dress up your creature and decorate their world

WHO IS MOMO FOR?

Students buried in stress

People with ADHD or low motivation

Anyone who needs a little nudge (and a lot of cuteness)

Try Momo AI for free and see what changes when you stop going it alone.
